title: 第7章 黑石镇的危机第8章 小镇的守护
lines: 荒野的尽头，终于不再是一片荒凉。
延绵百里的废土碎石平原慢慢收窄，地面从干裂苍白的辐射裸土，渐渐变成硬实的泥土路。零星残存的旧时代路基笔直穿过旷野，一直延伸到远处那座低矮的石城轮廓——那就是黑石镇，白峰城百里之内唯一还有人住、还能勉强挡住凶兽和重度辐射的人类据点。
风渐渐小了，高空漂浮的辐射尘缓缓下沉，停滞在街道上空。空气中刺鼻的腐蚀味被一种更厚重、更窒息的死气掩盖。这不是荒野那种无人的寂静，而是好几百活人被暴力压垮了反抗、掐灭了希望之后，硬生生憋出来的那种压抑。整座小镇就像一具被扼住喉咙的身体，苟延残喘，默默下沉。
陆寻慢慢往前走，左腿上还没好透的伤疤被粗布衣服磨得隐隐作痛。这种细碎的疼顺着骨头缝蔓延，时刻提醒他：身体是有极限的，在废土上活着，从来都不容易。看见人类据点，他并没有放松警惕，背依旧微微绷着，目光扫过路上每一处破损的地面、每一片凌乱的痕迹。荒野的危险是明着来的追杀，而人类聚集地里的恶意，却总是藏在平静的表面下，慢慢折磨你。
苏野紧跟在他身边，握枪的手臂一直绷着。这个从小在荒野村落长大的战士，比谁都清楚黑石镇的意义。在这片辐射遍地、凶兽横行的废土上，一座有围墙、有人住、还有淡水储备的小镇，本该是流民和幸存者的避难所。可越是稀少的安稳，就越容易被贪婪撕碎。
“黑石镇以前是这片最稳的据点。”苏野压低声音，连呼吸都放轻了，好像怕吵到这座小镇压抑的气氛，“听说有旧时代传承者留下的微弱屏障，一直中和着周围的辐射，凶兽不敢靠近，流匪也不敢来抢。这里是方圆百里唯一能安心种地、养活人、休养生息的地方。但半年前，屏障毫无预兆地减弱消失，保护没了，蹲在附近的黑风寨盗匪，立马就扑上来啃这块肥肉。”
林小满走在队伍中间，小心地展开精神感知，不敢过度消耗体力，却始终笼罩着整座小镇。在她的感知里，没有鲜活、跳动、热烈的生命波动，整个聚居区的生灵频率低沉、微弱、停滞，就像一潭多年不见阳光的死水，所有生机都被一层层压住、榨干，只剩下勉强维持的一点余温。
整座小镇，几十万平方米的居住区，活人的情绪就像一潭死水。
“太压抑了。”林小满轻声说，声音里带着一丝掩饰不住的疲惫，“所有人的心跳都偏慢，肌肉长期紧绷，这是长期被掠夺、被恐吓、被屠杀后的本能反应。没有躁动，没有怨恨的爆发，连恐惧都是收敛的——所有人都在学着麻木地活下去，放弃了挣扎。”
三人越靠近小镇，周围的气氛就越沉重。
黑石镇没有守护生命的高墙，只有一圈当地人徒手垒起来的粗石围栏。石头堆得松散杂乱，缝里塞满了干枯的荆棘和生锈的铁皮，这是弱者拼尽全力筑起的最后一道防线。可这道防线早已多处倒塌，破损的墙歪斜坍塌，没人修、没人管，像一具被反复啃咬、碾压过的残躯，无力地圈住一座彻底失去生机、任人宰割的小镇。
镇口空荡荡的，没有岗哨，没有巡逻的人，没有半点烟火气。只有两具风干发黑的尸体斜靠在石墙根，衣服碎得像破絮，脖子上的刀伤早已碳化发黑。尸体曝晒多日，风吹尘盖，没人收殓、没人祭奠、没人敢靠近，成了镇口最冰冷的警告牌。
废土上的人命本来就像尘土一样轻，可一座住着人的小镇，任由同胞的尸体在野外腐烂、无人过问，这足以说明这里的秩序、道义和血性，早就被暴力彻底碾碎，一点不剩了。
陆寻停下脚步，盯着那两具尸体看了三秒，眼里没有波动，只有冰冷的清醒。
这不是凶兽干的，是人杀的。伤口平整利落，是刀砍出来的致命伤，是同类相残的痕迹。
“盗匪干的？”苏野咬着牙问，手心死死攥着猎枪，指节发白。
“是。”陆寻点头，目光锁定那两具尸体，语气冷得像冰，“杀鸡儆猴。故意把尸体留在这儿不埋，就是明摆着的威慑，告诉全镇的人：反抗，就是这个下场。恐惧，是他们统治这座小镇的工具。”
三人抬脚走进镇子。
眼前的景象，比荒野厮杀后的狼藉更让人窒息。
小镇全是低矮的石屋，墙裂着缝、漏着风，屋顶破烂不堪。街道泥泞不平，地上满是碎陶片、朽木头和破布条，每一处痕迹都写着“被反复抢劫”的狼狈。整条街死气沉沉，没有孩子哭，没有妇人低声说话，没有炊烟升起，也没有干活的动静。整座小镇像一座活坟墓，活人困在里面，一天天等死。
家家户户门窗紧闭，窗缝门缝堵得严严实实，大白天也暗得像夜里。偶尔有细微的视线从缝里偷偷探出来，飞快地扫过三人的身影，一察觉到不对劲，瞬间就缩回去藏起来——连偷看都不敢多看一眼，只剩下刻进骨子里的胆怯和恐惧。
还活着的人，全都在躲。
躲掠夺，躲屠杀，躲那逃不掉的绝望。
死寂突然被打破。
巷口炸开粗野嚣张的笑骂声，蛮横、轻浮、肆无忌惮，踩着全镇人的尊严随意践踏。紧接着传来的，是女人死死压住的呜咽，哭声细碎、发抖、破碎，不敢放大一点声音，只剩下极致的屈辱和无助，在死寂的街道里无力地回荡。
陆寻脚步一顿，全身肌肉瞬间绷紧，后背像拉满的硬弓。
林小满的感知立刻聚焦，尖锐暴戾的情绪波动直冲她脑海：“前面三十米，三个人。气息浮躁狂妄，习惯性欺负人，毫无敬畏——是长期欺凌弱者养出来的恶胆。”
苏野浑身血气上涌，眼里怒火炸开，身体往前冲了半步，杀意直接而滚烫。荒野厮杀有规矩、有底线，但这种仗势欺人、践踏妇孺的卑劣行径，最让人看不起。
“别冲动。”
陆寻抬手按住他的肩膀，力道沉稳，压住了苏野那股躁动的血性。
废土上，热血最容易要命。一时的痛快报仇，只会打草惊蛇，让整座小镇遭到毁灭性的报复。零零散散杀几个没有用，要破这个局，就得连根拔起，一口气撕碎这笼罩了小镇半年的黑暗。
content_en:
The end of the wilderness is finally no longer desolate.
The wasteland gravel plain that stretches for hundreds of miles slowly narrows, and the ground gradually changes from cracked, pale radiated bare soil to a hard dirt road. Scattered remnants of the roadbed from the old era run straight through the wilderness and extend to the outline of the low stone city in the distance - that is Blackstone Town, the only human stronghold within a hundred miles of White Peak City that still has people living in it and can barely block the ferocious beasts and heavy radiation.
The wind gradually died down, and the radioactive dust floating in the sky slowly sank and stagnated above the streets. The acrid corrosive smell in the air was masked by a thicker, more suffocating smell of death. This is not the deserted silence of the wilderness, but the kind of depression that is forcibly suppressed after hundreds of living people have been crushed by violence to resist and extinguish hope. The whole town was like a body strangled by the throat, lingering and sinking silently.
Lu Xun walked forward slowly, the scar on his left leg that had not healed was aching from the rough clothes. This kind of tiny pain spreads along the seams of his bones, always reminding him that his body has its limits, and living in the wasteland is never easy. When he saw the human stronghold, he did not relax his vigilance. His back was still slightly tensed, and his eyes scanned every damaged ground and every messy trace on the road. The danger in the wilderness is obvious pursuit, but the malice in human gathering places is always hidden under the calm surface, slowly tormenting you.
Su Ye followed him closely, the arm holding the gun kept tense. This warrior who grew up in a wilderness village knows the significance of Blackstone Town better than anyone else. In this wasteland filled with radiation and ferocious beasts, a walled, inhabited town with fresh water reserves should have been a refuge for refugees and survivors. But the rarer the stability, the easier it is to be torn apart by greed.
"Blackstone Town used to be the most stable stronghold in this area." Su Ye lowered his voice and even breathed softly, as if he was afraid of disturbing the oppressive atmosphere of the town. "I heard that there was a weak barrier left by the inheritors of the old era, which has been neutralizing the surrounding radiation. The ferocious beasts dare not approach. Even the bandits dare not come to rob it. This is the only place within a hundred miles where one can safely farm, feed people, and recuperate. But half a year ago, the barrier weakened and disappeared without warning. The bandits from Heifeng Village squatting nearby immediately rushed to eat this piece of fat. "
Lin Xiaoman walked in the middle of the team, carefully unfolding his mental perception, not daring to exert too much energy, but always covering the whole town. In her perception, there were no fresh, beating, or enthusiastic life fluctuations. The frequency of life in the entire settlement was low, weak, and stagnant, like a pool of stagnant water that had not seen sunlight for many years. All vitality was suppressed and drained layer by layer, leaving only a barely maintained residual warmth.
In the entire town, with hundreds of thousands of square meters of residential area, the emotions of the living people were like a pool of stagnant water.
"It's too depressing." Lin Xiaoman said softly, with a trace of unconcealed exhaustion in his voice. "Everyone's heartbeats are slow and their muscles are tense for a long time. This is an instinctive reaction after being robbed, intimidated, and slaughtered for a long time. There is no restlessness, no outbreak of resentment, and even fear is restrained - everyone is learning to live numbly and gives up struggling."
The closer the three of them got to the town, the heavier the atmosphere around them became.
There is no high wall to protect life in Blackstone Town, only a rough stone fence built by local people with their bare hands. The stones were piled loosely and messily, and the cracks were filled with dry thorns and rusty iron sheets. This was the last line of defense built by the weak with all their strength. But this line of defense has already collapsed in many places. The damaged walls are crooked and collapsed, with no one repairing or caring about them. They are like a broken body that has been repeatedly chewed and crushed, powerlessly enclosing a town that has completely lost its vitality and is at the mercy of others.
The entrance to the town was deserted, with no sentries, no patrols, and no fireworks. There were only two dried and black bodies leaning against the stone wall. Their clothes were in pieces, and the stab wounds on their necks had long been carbonized and turned black. The corpse had been exposed to the sun for many days, covered with wind and dust. No one collected it, paid homage to it, or dared to approach it. It became the coldest warning sign at the entrance of the town.
Human life in the wasteland is as light as dust, but in a small town where people live, the corpses of their compatriots are allowed to rot in the wild without anyone caring about them. This is enough to show that the order, morality and blood here have long been completely crushed by violence, and there is no trace left.
Lu Xun stopped and stared at the two corpses for three seconds. There was no fluctuation in his eyes, only cold sobriety.
This was not done by a ferocious beast, but by a human being. The wound was smooth and clean, a fatal wound caused by a knife, and a trace of cannibalism.
"Did bandits do it?" Su Ye asked through gritted teeth, clutching the shotgun tightly in his hand, his knuckles turning white.
"Yes." Lu Xun nodded, his eyes locked on the two corpses, and his tone was as cold as ice, "Kill the chicken to scare the monkeys. Deliberately leaving the corpses here without burying them is an obvious deterrent, telling the people in the town: Resistance will lead to this. Fear is their tool to rule this town."
The three of them walked into the town.
The scene in front of me was more suffocating than the mess after a fight in the wilderness.
The town is full of low stone houses with cracked walls and leaky roofs. The streets were muddy and uneven, and the ground was covered with broken pottery shards, rotten wood and rags. Every trace showed the embarrassment of being repeatedly robbed. The whole street was lifeless. No children were crying, no women were whispering, no smoke was rising, and there was no movement of people working. The whole town is like a living tomb, with the living trapped inside, waiting to die day by day.
The doors and windows of every house were closed, and the cracks in the windows and doors were tightly blocked. It was as dark as night even in broad daylight. Occasionally, a subtle gaze peeked out from the cracks, quickly scanning the figures of the three people. As soon as they sensed something was wrong, they immediately retracted and hid themselves - not even daring to take a peek, leaving only the timidity and fear engraved in their bones.
Everyone who is still alive is hiding.
Avoid plunder, avoid massacre, and avoid the inescapable despair.
The dead silence was suddenly broken.
Wild and arrogant laughter and curses erupted at the entrance of the alley. They were arrogant, frivolous, and unscrupulous, trampling on the dignity of the whole town at will. What came next was the woman's tightly suppressed sobs. Her cries were thin, trembling, and broken. She didn't dare to make her voice louder, leaving only the ultimate humiliation and helplessness, echoing feebly in the dead streets.
Lu Xun paused, his muscles tightened instantly, and his back was like a fully stretched bow.
Lin Xiaoman's perception immediately focused, and sharp and violent mood swings rushed into her mind: "Thirty meters in front, there are three people. They have impetuous and arrogant auras, habitual bullying, and no fear - they are the evil courage developed by bullying the weak for a long time."
Su Ye's blood surged all over his body, his eyes exploded with anger, and he rushed forward half a step, his killing intent direct and hot. There are rules and bottom lines for fighting in the wilderness, but this despicable behavior of bullying others and trampling on women and children is the most despicable.
"Don't be impulsive."
Lu Xun raised his hand and pressed his shoulder with a steady force, suppressing Su Ye's restless blood.
In the wasteland, hot blood is most likely to kill someone. A moment of happy revenge will only alert the enemy and cause the entire town to suffer devastating revenge. It's useless to kill a few here and there. To break this situation, you have to uproot it and tear apart the darkness that has shrouded the town for half a year.
title_en: Chapter 7 The Crisis in Blackstone Town Chapter 8 The Guardian of the Town
